name: Check an existing 45/60/75 um fit
description: Check mode. Evaluates an interference band already on a drawing rather than solving for one. 45 to 75 um diametral on a 50 mm fit carrying 1000 N-m at 80 C. Roughness takes 6.4 um off the specified interference before any contact pressure appears. The hub heating limit of 200 C is a statement about the oven, not about the joint: assembly temperature itself is solved for.
